senses.gloss: splash from a spout (cmp. סִילּוֹן II), trnsf. צ׳ (של רוק) ejection of spittle.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:23">Y. Yoma I, 38ᵈ</cite> top <he>נתזה צ׳ של רוק וכ׳</he> spittle from his mouth flew on his (the high priest’s) garments; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 5:3">Tosef. Nidd. V, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 33b:55">Nidd. 33ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Niddah 33b:55">Ib.</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>צ׳ דעם הארץ</he> the spittle of an ignorant man (not observing levitical cleanness); <cite ref="Chagigah 23a:8">Ḥag. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>משום צ׳ וכ׳</he> because spittle of an ignorant man may have fallen on it; a. e.—Pl. <he>צִנּוֹרוֹת</he>, <cite ref="R00614"><he>צִינּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 5:4">Pirké d’R. El. ch. V</cite> <he>העבים … צִינּוֹרוֹתֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> the clouds cause the seas to hear the sound of their splashings (rain), and the seas cause the deep to hear &c. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 42:8">Ps. XLII, 8</cite>).
